description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5935144788370 CONNECTOR BODY,PLUG: Line 0001 Qty 22 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0274 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
